Resource Profile: MII PR Bildgebung Semistrukturierter Befundbericht

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-bildgebung/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-bildgebung-semistrukt-befundbericht Version: 2027.0.0-ballot.1
Active as of 2026-09-15 Computable Name: MII_PR_Bildgebung_Semistrukt_Befundbericht

The profile describes a semistructured report. It is an addition for the main medical report.

This Composition resource is used to record semi-structured diagnostic reports of imaging procedures.

The mapping of the dataset elements to this profile is documented in the Logical Model Bildgebung.

Examples

Example of a Composition resource representing the report in several sections. This offers the possibility to represent the report not only as free text or in structured form, but also chapter by chapter in a semi-structured form:

Composition-mii-exa-bildgebung-semistrukt-befundbericht

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Composition/mii-exa-bildgebung-semistrukt-befundbericht
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: MII CPS Bildgebung CapabilityStatement

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
